document.abstract: Raymond Sylvester Peck waa born at Ridgetown, Ontario, Canada, on February 2, 1886. He was one of the six children of Mr. and Mrs. W. R. Peck, the former a well known hotel man in that district. He waa a member of one of the oldest and best known families in the southwestern section of Ontario
